# ADR template

Use **[docs/adr/ADR-TEMPLATE.md](../adr/ADR-TEMPLATE.md)** — copy it to
`docs/adr/ADR-XXXX-<slug>.md`, fill it in, and add it to the [ADR index](../adr/README.md).

Required sections: Status · Date · Deciders · Touches · Context · Decision ·
Alternatives considered · Consequences · Compliance.

An ADR is required for any change to the **frozen v1.0 architecture**. Smaller
engineering decisions use [architecture-decision.md](architecture-decision.md) →
the [Engineering Decision Log](../project/ENGINEERING_DECISION_LOG.md).
